Approach play 3%) and total strokes gained 0%) dominate the model, rewarding players who hit greens and convert birdies.
preview.modelExplainer: Approach play 3%) and total strokes gained 0%) carry the heaviest weights, followed by putting 5%) and around-the-green 0%). Off-the-tee 0%) and accuracy metrics 2%) matter less, so the model favors ball-strikers who can scramble and putt when needed. These weights shift emphasis away from pure distance toward precision and short-game execution.
preview.pickApproach: We tier players by a blend of tournament rank and power rank, prioritizing those with strong approach and total SG marks. Tier-one bets target the top-five model names with the best combined approach and putting figures.

article.title: FedEx St. Jude Championship Model Targets: Knapp, Scheffler, Bridgeman Lead 69-Player Field
article.dek: Model ranks Jake Knapp #1, Scottie Scheffler #2, and Jacob Bridgeman #3 for TPC Southwind.
article.introduction: The tournament model places Jake Knapp at rank 1 with 002 SG Total and Scottie Scheffler at rank 2 with 868 SG Total. Jacob Bridgeman sits at rank 3 with 933 SG Total. All three players skipped the Scottish Open and carry zero tracked rounds in the post-Open window.

sections.heading: Tournament Overview
sections.body: The 69-player FedEx St. Jude Championship at TPC Southwind carries course weights of SG APP 3%, SG Total 0%, and SG Putt 5%. The model ranks the top three targets at 1-2-3 with SG Total values of 002, 868, and 933.

sections.heading: Course Fit

sections.heading: Recent Form
sections.body: Knapp enters with the model's highest SG Total at 002 and SG Putt at 285. Scheffler's 868 SG Total and 623 SG OTT rank second overall. Bridgeman's 933 SG Total and 339 SG Putt place him third.

sections.heading: Post-Open Workload

sections.body: Knapp sits at FedExCup rank #40, Scheffler at #1, and Bridgeman at #13. All three are classified SAFE_TOP_50 and face no immediate pressure to climb the standings.

sections.heading: Crossover Research Angles
sections.body: Each target skipped the Scottish Open and ranks inside the model's top-10. The combination of zero tracked rounds and top-10 model placement defines the shared profile for these three players.

sections.heading: Outright Targets
sections.body: Knapp (model rank 1, power rank 3) and Scheffler (model rank 2, power rank 1) are the two outright targets. Both carry SG Total marks above 86 and zero tracked rounds post-Open.

sections.heading: Top-10 Targets

sections.heading: Top-20 Targets

sections.heading: Data Limitations

sections.heading: Final Betting Card
sections.body: Strong model-supported tier: Knapp and Scheffler for outright, top-5, top-10, and top-20. Secondary tier: Bridgeman for top-10 and top-20 only.

article.conclusion: Primary card: Knapp and Scheffler across all bet types. Secondary card: Bridgeman for top-10 and top-20. All three share zero tracked rounds and top-10 model placement.
